name: krep-mcp-server
description: High-performance string search MCP server based on krep

scripts.optimize: terser src/index.js -o src/index.min.js && terser src/mcp_server.js -o src/mcp_server.min.js
scripts.analyze: npx tree-sitter parse src/index.js > analysis/index.tree.json && npx tree-sitter parse src/mcp_server.js > analysis/mcp_server.tree.json
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run format && npm run optimize
scripts.push: git add . && git commit -m 'Optimized code with automatic syntax analysis' && git push
